verdict.rationale: Slack's own docs mention threads, and AI can summarize channels and threads for catch-up. Nothing shows every conversation must sit under a named topic or thread, and community reports say Slack pushes discussion into the main channel, with threads hard to use and poor at notifying users of replies. missing for 10: enforced or named per-conversation topics, first-party documentation of threading behavior itself, evidence that threads make busy channels easy to catch up on.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps, giving you the information you need to stay organized and in the know.
